sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Public entry point for schedule loaders
sections.what: Makes three schedule-reading functions available to the rest of the app through one import location.
sections.why: Keeps callers from depending on the internal layout of the normalize folder.

summary: Public entry point for the source-neutral schedule records, exposing three loading functions to the rest of the app.
purpose: Gives other parts of the app one short, stable place to import schedule loaders from, without needing to know the internal file layout.
why: Likely reason: keeps callers independent from the internal file names in the normalize folder.
how: Imports three functions from the service module and lists them in the public export list.
inputs: None directly. It re-exports functions that take a database file path and a project identifier.
outputs: Three functions: iter_activities, iter_relationships and load_project.
risks: Adding a function to the service without listing it here will make it unavailable through this import path.
debug: If an import of one of these names fails, check that the name is spelled the same here and in the service file.
